title: Governance Ledger Event
description: Canonical attributable, append-only, integrity-linked, totally ordered Governance Ledger event. DS-040 records or references governance submissions, context and state records, evidence and qualification results, authority and approvals, decisions and authorizations, refusals, commitments, enforcement outcomes, lifecycle transitions, continuation events, governance compilation and activation, and associated evidence. It preserves authoritative event ordering within an explicit ledger stream, supports per-proposal and dependent-event reconstruction, Derived Lifecycle State, deterministic replay, audit reconstruction, tenant isolation, cryptographic integrity, correction by subsequent event rather than mutation, and long-term verification. Timestamps, arrival order, storage order, node identity, and transport behavior are never authoritative ordering bases. A Governance Ledger event records governance history; it does not itself establish authority at commitment, authorize execution, alter the referenced artifact, or replace qualified authoritative sources used to resolve Canonical State.

governance_ledger_id.description: Stable identifier for a Governance Ledger.

governance_ledger_event_id.description: Stable identifier for a Governance Ledger event.

ledger_position.description: Authoritative position in an append-only totally ordered ledger stream. Timestamps are not an ordering basis.

governance_ledger_event_ref.description: Stable integrity-bound reference to a DS-040 Governance Ledger event.

ordering_scope.description: Explicit stream within which Governance Ledger events are totally ordered.

event_subject.description: Identity-bound subject of the ledger event.

causality.description: Explicit causal and dependent-event relationships independent of transport or arrival timing.

governance_basis_snapshot.description: Versioned governance basis sufficient to reconstruct the governance meaning of the event.

event_artifact_refs.description: Canonical artifact and outcome references recorded by the event; no unrestricted generic payload is permitted.

namespaced_extensions.description: Namespaced non-normative extensions that cannot alter ordering, integrity, append-only, authority, or lifecycle semantics.
